newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks end sharply up on technical boost.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks end sharply up on technical boost.

text.p: Taiwan share prices closed sharply higher on Saturday as investors received a technical jolt of confidence following the market's successful defence of a key support level on Friday, brokers said.
The weighted index extended its gains throughout Saturday's shortened session before closing 1.98 percent or 158.62 points higher at 8,163.11.
Turnover was an active T$79 billion.
The index, which dipped below the 8,000-point support level on Thursday, managed to nudge back up on Friday despite heavy profit-taking pressure.
"Investors were afraid that after dropping below 8,000, the market would begin to plunge," said Oliver Fang, senior analyst for National Securities.
"But that did not happen on Friday, and therefore some technical-based confidence was restored," Fang said.
Bargain-hunting focused on long-downtrodden construction sector stocks, which soared 4.38 percent.
But brokers said they remained skeptical about the market's extended upside room despite Saturday's gains.
"It is hard to say that one session would be able to reverse a downtrend," Fang said.

The market, beset by political jitters and concerns over social disorder, has been mired in a low-turnover consolidation phase for more than a month, struggling to rekindle the kind of sustained rally seen earlier in the year.
A 8,050-8,200 range was seen for Monday.
